author: Ben
title: PortMiami passed 10 million cruise passengers in FY2026
detail: Above the prior record of 8.56M. 20.6M of 37.2M cruise passengers worldwide in 2025 were sourced from the U.S.
whoAffected: Cruise passengers, terminals, transport and hospitality around the port
implication: Record volume through one place: any friction around embarkation day scales.

sources.label: PortMiami, Sep. 2026: Passed 10 million cruise passengers in fiscal year 2026 (Oct. 2025 to Sep. 2026), above the prior record of 8.56 million
CLIA, State of the Cruise Industry 2026: 37.2 million cruise passengers worldwide in 2025, of which 20.6 million sourced from the U.S.; the Caribbean is about 43% of global deployments
